requirements.original_spec: Exactly 120.00 seconds, 60 fps, 7200 frames; Bilibili 3840x2160; Xiaohongshu 1080x1920 or 2160x3840.
Shared stereo PCM master, 48000 Hz, 5760000 samples per channel; -18 to -16 LUFS and true peak <= -1.0 dBTP.
Keep top 8%, right 14%, bottom 22% clear; stack HUD at 9%-15%; captions 24%-28% from bottom, at most two lines and 14 Chinese characters per line, effective font >=13 px at 360 px preview.
No Math.random() or Date.now(); frame-driven deterministic motion; no shot or title card static for more than 180 frames.
Preserve the exact three left-side act strings and exact right-side reward and distance strings.
Preserve S01-S10 original script, displayed subtitles, TTS phonetic text, and exact frame windows from the brief.

Frames 0-1260: cyan lattice tower, emerald verifier plane, every 15 frames ten candidates with nine red failures and one gold survivor. At frame 1260, cross the labeled formalizable-reality ceiling and enter the void.

requirements.original_spec: Frames 1800-2700: tiny amber clinical-trial probe, ten-year wait dial, trapped cyan core. Frames 2700-3600: split at 2880 into generator and internal reward judge, figure-eight orbit and cyan-to-magenta reward beams.
requirements.time_values: The 10,000,000-year live counter is an illustrative intermediate value; the full ten-year wait is labeled 100,000,000 subjective years (x10^7). This distinction and its rationale are documented in project/scientific-notes.md:8.

requirements.original_spec: Frames 3600-5400: genuine 4D-projected Klein immersion with six recursive lace layers; split-screen physical baseline, zero displacement and damaged/toxic cell.

Frames 5400-6300: return the amber probe and physical verdict; preserve 30-frame absolute silence, then drop/shatter and complete collapse within 18 frames. Frames 6300-6930: quote/title. Frames 6930-7200: Landauer cliffhanger.
requirements.interpretation: Silence is [5820,5850); impact begins at 5850 and collapse completes at 5868. This resolves the brief's conflicting arrival-at-5820 and silence-starting-at-5820 wording and is explicitly documented.

requirements.original_spec: Distinguish formal correctness from semantic truth; treat time, scores, parameters, energy and clinical outcome as illustrative; do not imply consciousness or that all self-play is harmful.
